newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates close unchanged after repo cut.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates close unchanged after repo cut.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates closed unchanged at 23.50 percent on Tuesday in what traders said was light activity following Monday's National Bank of Hungary repo rate cut.
"There is very little money on the market and the prices are rather high," said Sandor Tolonics of Budapest Bank.
The NBH cut both the overnight and one-week repo rates to 28.75 percent and reduced its one-week reverse repo to 22.75 percent and its one-month reverse repo to 23.25 percent.
